answer.reason: Two events in the verses belong to the island: Titus was left there to ordain elders, and Paul's ship sailed close by it before the storm.

clauses.english: was where Titus was left to set things in order and ordain elders in every city
clauses.quote: For this cause left I thee in Crete

clauses.english: was sailed close by Paul's ship before a tempestuous wind struck it

doubts: ZEP 2:5 names the Cherethites of the Philistine coast, not the island, so I left it out.
TIT 1:12 only reports a saying about the Cretians, which is not an event, so I left it out.
